en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Hassan Bin Mahboub, from one of his companions, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> having said:
‘Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic is Pleased with you all with Al-Islām as a Religion, therefore make good your companionship with the generously, and good mannerisms’.
en.sarwar: 4. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Hassan ibn Mahbub from certain individuals of his people from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following: “
Allah, the Most Majestic, the Most Holy, has chosen Islam to be your religion. Keep good company with your religion by means of exercising generosity and good moral behavior.”
